methods.title: Wrapper integrity
methods.summary: Inspect Gradle wrapper files, distribution URLs and configured checksums before build or sync.

methods.title: Script safety
methods.summary: Inspect shell, batch and PowerShell source for risky download, execution and credential patterns.

methods.title: Gradle build configuration
methods.summary: Review Gradle plugins, repositories and execution-related configuration without running Gradle.

methods.title: Version catalog policy
methods.summary: Review Gradle version catalogs for dynamic dependency versions and configuration risks.

methods.title: Script call graph
methods.summary: Trace statically identifiable script calls and display their execution paths.

methods.title: Maven configuration
methods.summary: Review local POM repository URLs and unpinned dependency versions without running Maven.

methods.title: Android / Ktor · Semgrep
methods.summary: Inspect Kotlin and Java source with curated Android/Ktor review rules or an explicitly selected rule file. No build is executed.

methods.title: Python · Bandit
methods.summary: Analyze Python with an installed Bandit scanner, or import its JSON report.

methods.title: PowerShell · PSScriptAnalyzer
methods.summary: Analyze a source snapshot with an installed PowerShell analyzer, or import its JSON report.

methods.title: SAST · SARIF
methods.summary: Connect findings from a SARIF 2.1.0 producer, including organization-specific tools.

methods.title: Dependencies · Trivy
methods.summary: Scan supported local dependency inputs using an installed Trivy, or import its vulnerability report.

methods.title: Dependencies · OSV-Scanner
methods.summary: Check resolved dependency inputs using an installed OSV-Scanner, or import its JSON report.

methods.title: Web application · ZAP
methods.summary: Import a ZAP report for an explicitly scoped application target. Requires a target origin; sends no requests.

methods.title: Script behavior signals
methods.summary: Inspect bounded literal decoding and linked behavior signals in Python and PowerShell without running source code. Advisory research method.

methods.title: Local AI review
methods.summary: Ask a configured local model to explain selected findings. Advisory only; no source files are sent and no model is bundled.

methods.title: External issues · Sonar generic JSON
methods.summary: Import legacy or current Sonar generic issue data from your own analyzer without connecting a cloud account.

methods.title: SBOM / VEX · CycloneDX
methods.summary: Import CycloneDX JSON vulnerability assessments. Inventory alone is incomplete; producer VEX statements never become host-approved exceptions.
